message: 幻の一大事

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? What's that sound--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Target acquired: Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte! Why are you in your uniform...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because we're going to school, obviously!」

name: Synn
message: 「Today's Sunday, you know. Plus, KiraFes just ended, so nobody's even going to be there.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Which is precisely what makes going all the more worthwhile, don't you think?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?! D-Don't tell me you're planning to rob the place...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Stop complaining and just come with me!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady. If you are in a hurry, would you care to make use of these?」

name: Synn
message: 「What on earth are you planning to do with cotton balls and chloroform?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Okay, okay, I get it. Still, if we're going to school, I need to get changed first...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, leave it all to me!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Things are moving way too fast!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「And where the hell did you pull this thing up to?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My sincerest apologies.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That takes care of all our preparations. Well then, we're off.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Have a safe trip.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look forward to the souvenirs, okay~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Prier...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You see, at KiraFes yesterday, I happened to hear a certain rumor from the Wagashi Club.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh-ho~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That Prier has a phantom menu item.」

name: Synn
message: 「A phantom... menu item?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Makes you curious, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah. I've pretty much only ever eaten the kaiware ramen here, so I had no idea a menu item like that existed.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't underestimate my intelligence network.」

name: Synn
message: 「And speaking of the source of that info...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Misasagi-senpai!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Wouldn't you say there's no time to be aiding the enemy?」
She is unusually cutthroat.

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be limited-edition or something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's rare enough to be called a phantom, after all. One for the President, one for me, and one for Jiiya--we'll need at least three.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What about yours truly's share?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A plushie eating food isn't realistic.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Stop treating me like an inanimate object only at times like this?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Quiet down.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. Let us sit seiza in solemn silence and prepare for the moment to come.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The way of wagashi also begins with courtesy and ends with courtesy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... so it really is a traditional Japanese sweet?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a phantom wagashi!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha?! What is it, what is it?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Three chimes of the bell.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-this means it's limited to three servings!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-is that what that means?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Probably, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Just 'probably,' huh.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here it is.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-This is... the legendary traditional sweet!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「This sweet is called Joshin Matsuba. It takes a great deal of time and effort to make, and only a handful of artisans can prepare it, making it a truly elusive menu item.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So how did something like that end up here at Prier?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems they stock it irregularly. Apparently, a mysterious artisan makes it out of mysterious goodwill.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Such a legendary item is sitting right before your eyes!? Shouldn't you be feeling a little more moved than that?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I've eaten this before.」

name: Synn
message: 「These are soba sticks, right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, what an uncouth way to put it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no... I was just thinking about how I used to eat them a lot at Nanaka's place back in the day~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does the Treasurer's family run some kind of 'broker' business?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, her dad is a soba craftsman.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What does soba have to do with a legendary sweet?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Joshin Matsuba is a type of soba confection. Could that mysterious artisan possibly be...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's dad, maybe.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hello, Rii-a. I'm heading straight over to Yuugiri-an right now. Please make sure everything is arranged nicely.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I've fallen for Yuugiri-san all over again. Terribly sorry for the intrusion.」
Saying that, Misasagi-senpai hurried away.
Yuugiri-an is surprisingly popular, isn't it.
Thanks to that, we managed to secure enough for everyone without a hitch.

name: Synn
message: 「Waa, I get it! I'll give you mine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President... how very kind of you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, to me it's less of a legendary treat and more of a nostalgic sweet, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Did you used to eat it with the Treasurer?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Nanaka would hold one end of this stick in her mouth, and make me hold the other end in mine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then we'd eat it together, and whoever broke it first lost.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oho~」

name: Synn
message: 「Even when I told her it was embarrassing because our faces got so close, she'd say, 'It's fine, it's fine' and insist on doing it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though Nanaka was always the one who lost, anyway.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heeh~ That sounds like fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Looking back now, it's a fond memory.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since we have the chance, why don't we try it?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Me and you, Lolotte!? Th-That's...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's the harm?」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Let's not! Taking your share would definitely be too bad of me, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite alright. I properly have some for Jiiya as well, and I... was deeply moved by your mercy, President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, that's not the issue--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's fine. I will properly aim to win, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, that's the problem!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here, go ahead.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uuu~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmph.\s04」
Our eyes... our eyes met, and her face is so close.
Her smooth, silky white skin keeps getting closer and closer.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nom, nom.」
She doesn't look the slightest bit embarrassed.
She keeps eating forward without any hesitation. How terrifying!
Even so, just rolling over and losing wouldn't be very manly either.
Alright! Somehow, I've just gotta make Lolotte laugh--

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Munch, munch, gulp. Yay, I win~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey there.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have come to escort you.」
Of all times, she doesn't make a single sound.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here, it's a soba stick souvenir~~♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady......?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You have to open your mouth nice and wide.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's thin, so you'll be fine.」

name: Riesling
message: 「No, that is not the issue...... eating while standing is still......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here, say ahh~♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「As I said, my lady......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please remember our do-or-die landing operation.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Back then, we were permitted neither food nor drink...... chomp!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How is it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is delicious.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. You must make sure to chew your food properly.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Going out of your way for someone like me...... thank you very much.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all, it's a thank-you for always taking such good care of me.」

name: Riesling
message: 「My sincerest apologies.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, I'm surprised. To think Treasurer-san's father can make traditional sweets.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, rather than sweets... he just likes making creative soba dishes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There are still so many things I don't know~~. But--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The more I learn about things I didn't know, the more I find myself coming to love them.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that's great.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whether it's the town, the people, the academy, or anything else. With discovery after discovery, the things I love just keep increasing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Must be tough having so many.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe, I suppose I shouldn't be too fickle.」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. Tonight's dinner is the legendary pilaf.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please leave out the green peas!」
It seems she doesn't come to love just anything.
